verdict.rationale: Aider's own docs say you can add images to the chat as visual context, such as screenshots, alongside its ability to write code in html, css, javascript and other languages. That supports image-informed code generation, but nothing shows it turning a design into a working app. missing for 10: explicit design/sketch-to-working-app workflow documentation, PDF design input support, evidence the generated app actually runs, independent or hands-on corroboration of image-to-app results.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can generate a working app from a sketch, image, or PDF design

citations.quote: Add images and web pages to the chat to provide visual context, screenshots, reference docs, etc.
Aider works with most popular programming languages: python, javascript, rust, ruby, go, cpp, php, html, css, and dozens more.
